description: Chargers near a place or point: "EV chargers near Boulder", "fast chargers near Union Station, Denver", "Tesla/NACS chargers near me" (with the driver's city, ZIP code or coordinates), "is there a working charger at the Costco in Fort Collins?". Send place (a U.S. city, address, ZIP code, landmark or business name) or lat and lng; optional speed (dcfc = DC fast), min_power_kw, connector, network and radius. Lists in-service stations only (removed and temporarily closed ones are left out). Each station comes with its distance in miles, network, connector types, power in kW, DC fast and Level 2 port counts, price where known, the date its details were last confirmed and its ChargingNear.me page link (url), plus live port availability where a live reading exists (included for clients with a commercial API key). Results are sorted by distance, nearest first. With place, the answer's place field names the match.

available_now.description: Only stations showing a free port in a live reading under 15 minutes old. Live availability is available only to clients with a commercial API key; without one, this filter is ignored and the answer lists it under ignored_filters.

connector.description: Plug type, case-insensitive: NACS (Tesla), CCS, CHAdeMO or J1772, or a raw NREL code (TESLA, J1772COMBO, CHADEMO). Comma-separate to match any.

lat.description: Latitude (with lng), if you have coordinates instead of a place

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50, 150, 250). 150 and up only match stations with a known wattage.

network.description: Network name contains, e.g. Tesla, Electrify America, ChargePoint

place.description: A U.S. city, address, ZIP code, landmark or business name, e.g. "Union Station, Denver, CO" or "80202". Use instead of lat and lng; sent with them, the match nearest that point is used.

speed.description: Charging level: dcfc (DC fast), level2 or level1

name: get_nearest_stations
title: Nearest charging stations
